answer_1.quote: We propose TrickCatcher, an LLM-powered test case generation approach for detecting bugs in plausible programs... It consists of three steps: program variant generation, test input generation, and differential testing.
answer_1.outputs: program variants, input generators, test inputs, test cases (input–oracle pairs)

answer_2.quote: We define precision, recall, and F1-score: • Precision is defined as #TP/(#TP+#FP) ... • Recall is defined as #TP/(#TP+#FN) ... • F1 score is defined as 2×Precision×Recall/(Precision+Recall).
